meta.title: Flowin
meta.description: Monitor and manage LinkedIn outreach operations for every brand from one place.

login.title: Admin Sign In
login.subtitle: Sign in with your team credentials to continue.
login.footer: This area is for authorized team members only.

brands.title: Select a brand
brands.subtitle: Choose the brand you want to view to continue.
brands.connectBody: Adding a brand connects that brand’s LinkedIn account to Flowin. LinkedIn still opens its own permission screen, even if you are already logged in another tab — sometimes it asks for the password again. Continue with the brand account. If that account is already connected, you’ll see a warning.
brands.alreadyConnected: This LinkedIn account is already connected.
brands.connectConfig: The LinkedIn app is not configured yet.
brands.connectScope: In LinkedIn Products, request access to “Sign in with LinkedIn using OpenID Connect”, then try connecting again.
brands.firebaseUnconfigured: LinkedIn connected, but Firestore could not save the brand. Add a Firebase service account (FIREBASE_CLIENT_EMAIL and FIREBASE_PRIVATE_KEY) to .env.local and restart the server.
brands.emptyList: No brands connected yet. Connect a LinkedIn account to start.
brands.photoHint: If you change the photo on LinkedIn, click “Update from LinkedIn” here to refresh it.
brands.photoMissing: LinkedIn did not send a photo for this account. Make sure the profile has a photo, then connect again.
brands.deleteFailed: The brand could not be deleted. Make sure the server is running, then try again.
brands.outreachConnected: Unipile outreach is connected for this brand.
brands.outreachPending: LinkedIn login finished. Refresh if the outreach status is still updating.
brands.outreachConfig: Add UNIPILE_DSN and UNIPILE_API_KEY to the server environment, then try again.

create.title: Create New Campaign
create.subtitle: Create a new outreach campaign for the selected brand.
create.name: Campaign Name
create.profileUrlHint: Paste a LinkedIn profile URL. With outreach connected, name and title come from Unipile; otherwise the URL is stored as-is. Add people one by one.
create.profileUrlInvalid: Enter a valid LinkedIn profile URL.
create.profileUrlFailed: The profile could not be fetched. Check the URL and outreach connection.
create.noExistingLists: No list to reuse yet. Upload a CSV or Excel file.
create.importHint: Upload your filtered list as CSV or Excel. Rows with a full name and LinkedIn profile URL are imported.
create.importDrop: Choose a file or drop it here
create.importEmpty: No valid rows. The file needs name and LinkedIn URL columns.
create.importInvalid: That file could not be read. Try CSV or Excel.
create.salesNavHint: Paste a Sales Navigator people-search URL. Flowin pulls the list through the brand’s Unipile seat — it does not scrape LinkedIn itself.
create.salesNavEmpty: No people were returned for that search.
create.salesNavFailed: The list could not be imported. Check the URL and outreach connection.
create.salesNavNeedOutreach: Connect Unipile outreach on the brands page before importing a Sales Navigator list.
create.summaryNeedFile: Upload a CSV or Excel file.
create.summaryNeedProfileUrl: Add at least one LinkedIn profile URL.
create.flowHint: Fixed Flowin sequence. Copy and delays here are what the runner sends through Unipile.

settings.pacingHint: The number you set is the ceiling, not a daily quota to fill. Jitter and weekday hours (09:00–18:00 Europe/Istanbul) mean one day may send 4 and another 8. For a new seat, 8 / 12 / 15 is safe. Unused leftover does not roll over.
